slides.texte_overlay:
What growing up without a father
teaches a man

1. Independence.

He never waited for help.

2. Respect for mothers.

He saw the double shifts.

3. Emotional depth.

He had to understand
his own feelings.

4. Self-education.

Every lesson, he went
and found himself.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Self-education.

He learns every day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
6. Purpose.

He'll be the father
he never had.
